ordered_branches.explanation: Initialize fixed preference/type groups and a four-entry nonproduction server-name list; choose environment branches using @@SERVERNAME. Initialize history-day constants 7, 30, 90, 180 and 372, delete-loop limit 10 and per-delete TOP limit 500000. These are implementation values, not recommended retention policy. Reclassify selected system-created archive and generic configuration records using process-stamp checks and exclusion lists. Capture a custom-preference exclusion set, normalize USER_DEF fields with environment-specific override handling, and replace selected archive process identifiers. Remove two specifically selected archive preferences and associated filter records. Allocate a system-config numeric key beginning at 5000 using an observed gap or maximum-plus-one fallback, then insert a fixed runbook-related system setting or update the existing setting key. cFilterDelete removes filters and preferences for eligible discovered tables/type records when the applicable environment override is absent. Later updates derive USER_DEF5/ACTIVE/RUN_BY_DEFAULT, USER_DEF6/SAVE_DATA and USER_DEF7/DAYS_HIST with special type groups, exclusions and environment branches. cArchiveCreate enumerates eligible base tables plus synthesized process/transaction history type names and inserts missing archive preferences. Four explicitly added tables are LABEL_PRINT_REQUEST, SSRS_PRINTING_REQUEST, UPLOAD_LOCATION_INVENTORY_ATTRIBUTES and UPLOAD_SERIAL_NUMBER. Parent archive identifiers and dynamic handler identifiers are stored as metadata; those handlers are not invoked by this body. cFilterCreate deletes and rebuilds filter header/detail/statement rows for selected preferences. It stores dynamic filter SELECT text for WORK_ORDER_HEADER and WORK_INSTRUCTION condition tests, LAUNCH_STATISTICS closed tests, and PROCESS_HISTORY/TRANSACTION_HISTORY type tests. It then attaches DATA_FILTER. These filter texts are persisted here rather than executed here. When DeleteLoopLimit is positive, cArchiveTruncate selects child archive tables whose parent preference has saving disabled, active enabled and default-run enabled, plus special process/transaction archive cases when no corresponding type preference requests saving. A metadata row-count existence test narrows targets; each non-null target is immediately TRUNCATE TABLE through QUOTENAME. There is no row/batch cap on a selected truncate. cArchiveDelete selects eligible archive preferences with saving disabled and active/default-run enabled. For each non-null target and positive DAYS_HIST, it constructs an age-based delete: DATE_TIME_STAMP <= CONVERT(DATE, GETUTCDATE()-DAYS_HIST), TOP 500000 ordered by DATE_TIME_STAMP, repeated ten times after one initial existence test. Two subsequent cHistDelete passes target AR_PROCESS_HISTORY and AR_TRANSACTION_HISTORY by configured type with saving disabled and active/default-run enabled. These type-specific deletes have no age predicate and no ORDER BY; they perform TOP 500000 up to ten iterations per cursor row. The same underlying table can be visited through more than one preference. Finally update scheduled-job activation/next-run metadata differently for the fixed environment groups, clear selected PARAMETER_DATA, and adjust active interval jobs with frequency below five minutes by adding five minutes to NEXT_RUN_DATE_TIME and setting minimum frequency five, subject to the stated USER_DEF6 exclusion. No scheduler is invoked here. UPDATE/INSERT/DELETE ARCHIVE_PREFERENCES; UPDATE GENERIC_CONFIG_DETAIL; INSERT/UPDATE SYSTEM_CONFIG_DETAIL. DELETE/INSERT FILTER_CONFIG_HEADER, FILTER_CONFIG_DETAIL and FILTER_STATEMENT; UPDATE SCHEDULED_JOBS. Dynamic TRUNCATE TABLE on selected archive table names; dynamic DELETE CTE on age-qualified selected tables and type-qualified AR_PROCESS_HISTORY/AR_TRANSACTION_HISTORY. Local table-variable inserts and cursor state only in addition to the above persistent effects. sp_executesql for each eligible truncate, age-delete, process-history delete and transaction-history delete. No other stored-procedure call is present. Reading DYNAMIC_CALLING_DETAIL and storing ARCHIVE_PROCESS does not execute that handler.
